_comment: TP texprep config (TEXTURE_PLAN 1.2 OverlayArr / MicroArr, 1.3 overlay and micro slices, 1.4 steps 8-9; owner TP). Schema: Tools/texprep.py docstring. OverlayArr_Mask channels: R coverage (Leaking003 / SurfaceImperfections003 opacity, Leaking012A wet streaks = the smooth end of its roughness, MetalPlates013 rust = 1 - metalness), G 1 - 0.5 coverage (darkening weight, unused by the shaders so far), B height p1..p99, A absolute smoothness 1 - roughness of the source (unremapped). OverlayArr_Normal: the source GL normal, flat where the coverage is 0 (pads). MicroArr_Albedo: grey modifier x 0.5 (mean exactly 0.5 linear, i.e. a modifier of mean 1), MicroArr_Normal: high-passed GL normal (mean slope 0).

slices.name: leaks
slices.use: anchored leak decal hanging from the top edge of a face (v 0.5-1.0 holds the decal, v 0-0.5 the opacity-0 pad)

slices.name: glass grime
slices.use: glass and spandrel grime (NocGlass, NocFacade), ConcreteAlley grime at 8 m

slices.name: rivulets
slices.use: wet rivulets on glass and paint (near band only)

slices.name: rust bleed
slices.use: rust runs on painted steel (SteelPainted x0.3)

slices.name: concrete pores
slices.use: NocSurface concrete rows, NocWet stone floors
